title: Epica-dml end hg.jpg
author: Hannes Grobe, AWI
description: End of the EDML ice core from a depth 2775 m; consists of meltwater which has formed at the basis of the ice sheet; the core was drilled 2002-2004 through the Antarctic ice sheet in the area of Dronning Maud Land by the project EPICA (European Project for Ice Coring in Antarctica)
